circuit-bases.argument: Fixing the gate basis embeds AC0 in ACC0. Fixed-modulus gates have constant-depth threshold simulations. Majority has bounded-fan-in logarithmic-depth circuits, and a constant number of such layers remains logarithmic depth. Dropping depth gives P/poly.
circuit-bases.provenance_note: Constructive basis checks; broad textbook citation not reread end-to-end this round.

resource-monotonicity.argument: Resource enlargement, deterministic-to-nondeterministic simulation, and ignoring advice preserve the claimed unions. A halting logarithmic-space machine has polynomially many configurations, establishing L⊆SC with the same machine.
resource-monotonicity.provenance_note: Checked against concrete finite-control definitions; baseline textbook is supporting reference.

uniform-circuit-time.argument: A logspace generator has polynomial running time; evaluate its polynomial-size output topologically. Conversely, unrolling a polynomial-time computation yields a polynomial-size circuit.

logcfl.argument: Uniform SAC1 characterization supplies NL⊆LogCFL⊆NC. L⊆NC and NL⊆NC follow.
logcfl.provenance_note: Printedp560 contains these inclusions with uniformity explicit.

advice.argument: Amplify error below 2^(-n-1), union-bound over inputs of length n, and fix the shared random string. BPP becomes deterministic advice computation; AM becomes nondeterministic advice computation.
advice.provenance_note: Elementary amplification/advice argument checked; original papers not reread in full this round.

polynomial-space-simulation.argument: Enumerate polynomial witnesses/choices and counters in polynomial space; each fixed PH level has a polynomial-space simulation. Polynomial-space deterministic configuration counting gives exponential time; Savitch converts exponential nondeterministic space into the same exponential-space union.
polynomial-space-simulation.provenance_note: Operational simulation checked; counting-specific source audit delegated to counting auditor.

deterministic-time-hierarchy.argument: Hierarchy separates polynomial time from 2^(O(n)) and separates the latter union from 2^(poly(n)). Constants/finite alphabet/multitape polynomial overhead do not alter these unions.
deterministic-time-hierarchy.provenance_note: Standard accepted hierarchy theorem assumed per user waiver; statement-to-union application reviewed.

nondeterministic-time-hierarchy.argument: The nondeterministic time hierarchy yields NE⊄NP and NEXP⊄NE. Do not exchange nondeterministic and deterministic classes.
nondeterministic-time-hierarchy.provenance_note: Standard accepted hierarchy theorem assumed; statement-to-union application reviewed.

space-hierarchy.argument: Space hierarchy separates exponential space from polynomial space and polynomial space from every polylogarithmic space bound. SC is within the latter; uniform NC is within it by Borodin Theorem4.
space-hierarchy.provenance_note: Borodin primary passage read directly; accepted space hierarchy statement assumed.

parity-lower-bound.argument: Parity is computable in L and ACC0[2] but has no polynomial-size constant-depth AND/OR/NOT circuit family.
parity-lower-bound.provenance_note: Standard accepted parity lower bound; its nonuniform scope checked.

acc-lower-bound.argument: Theorem1.1 directly rules out ACC0 for NTIME[2^n], hence NE and NEXP. Theorem1.2 uses E^NP and cannot be transferred to E.
acc-lower-bound.provenance_note: Direct primary Theorem1.1 and Lemma5.4 inspected.

nonuniform-undecidability.argument: Choose a nonrecursive set S of lengths and output the constant bit [n∈S] at length n. This is an AC0 family, while every uniform roster class is recursive. Constants suffice, so no encoding or unary-recognition overhead is needed.
nonuniform-undecidability.provenance_note: Explicit primary observation following Theorem4, printedp738. Quantum/counting total-language recursiveness cross-checked with their auditor.

nondeterministic-circuit-diagonalization.argument: For large n choose s=2^(floor(n/4)). Nondeterministic circuit descriptions with at most s gates have O(s log s) bits, so fewer than 2^(2^n) truth tables arise. Enumerate truth tables and circuits and evaluate all nondeterministic assignments using O(2^n) space. Choose an omitted truth table. This defeats every polynomial circuit bound eventually, proving a language in EXPSPACE outside NP/poly. Unrestricted time is essential.
nondeterministic-circuit-diagonalization.provenance_note: Independent constructive audit; not attributed as a verbatim published theorem.

WorkTape footprint measures the visited interval, not merely currently nonblank cells.
NL requires a finite bound on every branch and bounded workspace on every reachable configuration.
SC uses the same deterministic machine for both resources; halting freezes execution.
E/NE use linear exponents, EXP/NEXP/EXPSPACE union polynomial exponents. Polynomial machine-model overhead preserves these definitions.
AC0/ACC0/TC0/NC1/Ppoly allow arbitrary nonuniform families, including nonrecursive length languages.
Gate references are backwards Fin indices: acyclicity is structural.
ACC0 has one fixed modulus per family; finite fixed collections of moduli can be combined without length-dependent modulus.
Size counts gates and wires, not literal bit encoding; polynomial overhead preserves every roster size union.
Majority tie convention is at least half; constants and repeated wires give usual threshold gates.
